premises.scope: For joint density h(u,r), M(h)=int esssup_u h(u,r)dr bounds every U+psi(R), with no independence between U and R required.

For cap-one independent coordinates, s3(H)>=s and an invertible indefinite original-coordinate pair B with D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), density cap 3*400^(1/3)(D^2 kappa s)^(-1/6), arbitrary affine terms and arbitrary remaining spectrum.

premises.scope: Normalized linear combination of independent cap-one one-dimensional densities has density cap sqrt(2).

new_results.statement: For two disjoint original-coordinate normalized banks Y1,Y2, disjoint core Z, outside R, Q=W^T H W+2W^T C R+psi(R), W=(Y1,Y2,Z), if s3(H)>=s and the bank pair B is invertible indefinite with D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), then ||p_Q||inf <= 6*400^(1/3)(D^2 kappa s)^(-1/6). If B is definite, ||p_Q||inf <=2*pi/sqrt(|det B|). The third singular source may lie anywhere in Z; psi and C are arbitrary.

For protected H0 with s3(H0)>=s0 and bank pair gap beta0, signed added rank-one spectral terms have core leakage F with Delta=||F||. If Delta<min(s0,beta0), an indefinite pair obeys ||p_Q||inf <=6*400^(1/3)[(beta0-Delta)^5(s0-Delta)]^(-1/6); a definite pair obeys <=2*pi/(beta0-Delta). Added directions entirely outside the protected core cost zero regardless of sign, rank, or magnitude.

partner_result_actually_applied.application: After fixed-outside application of the arbitrary-rank indefinite-pair theorem, the joint core/outside mixed norm is bounded by the same constant; account04/B12 then adds the actual dependent measurable remainder psi(R) with no convolution or independence assumption.

unresolved_implication: From only s3(A)>=1, force two disjoint scalar banks with a quantitative nonsingular pair while retaining any third singular direction in the reduced core, or reach an already-paid physical-pair/ridge/localized branch; heavily overlapping Hadamard frames remain the stress case.
